title: Complete Sentences vs. Sentence Fragments
goal: The goal of this lesson is to help students understand the difference between complete sentences and sentence fragments.
summary: A complete sentence expresses a complete thought and contains at least a subject and a predicate. A sentence fragment is missing an essential part of a sentence or does not express a complete thought.

sections.title: Complete Sentences and Fragments
sections.content: A complete sentence expresses a complete thought and contains a subject and a predicate.

sections.title: Examples
content: Maria went to the store yesterday.

content.explanation: This is a fragment because it does not express a complete thought.
content.fix: She went to bed because she was tired.

content.explanation: This fragment does not identify who went to the store.
content.fix: Maria went to the store yesterday.

content.explanation: This is already a complete sentence.
